# Decode-limit specimen

`oversized.pdf` is generated with the exact pyHanko 0.38.1 CLI specimen,
`minimal_with_oversized_objstm()`. Run the included generator with the pinned
oracle interpreter. The fixture and generator retain the upstream MIT
license; see `LICENSE-pyHanko` in the repository root.

This is only an input artifact. Passing coverage requires native command
operations and their original negative/positive assertions.
